50/S0.subgoal: Explain the purpose of modeling realistic walking behavior in VR navigation.

50/S1.subgoal: Outline the four stages of the model development process.

50/S2.subgoal: Describe the empirical research process for collecting walking data from participants.

50/S3.subgoal: Explain the data analysis results and the identification of the 'slow in, slow out' (CISO) walking pattern.

50/S4.subgoal: Describe the mathematical model for walking speed using Fourier series and visual gain.

50/S5.subgoal: Summarize the evaluation study confirming the model's effectiveness for realism and presence.
